desc: Building off the Vanguard High Country, the Outfitter has an updated Cerekote, hand sponge paint, and a spiral-fluted barrel. Hunters can expect the same Weatherby Monte Carlo stock, crisp two-position trigger, and accurate hammer-forged barrel. The Vanguard Action has been a staple in the industry for over 50 years and features an integral recoil lug for a safe and robust action. This is the rifle you want when heading into the vast depths of the high country.
